description: Use this to see which countries and kinds of price the tools cover. It returns a short overview: for each tool the countries it answers for, how many official sources stand behind it and how often they update. Give category and/or country to get the full detail of the matching sources instead (publisher, licence, attribution line, limits, example requests). Every source at once, as JSON: https://proofprice.com/api/v1/coverage

category.description: Optional. Return the full detail of this category's sources: one of broadband, cars, childcare, commercial-property, construction, contracts, diet-costs, energy, farm-gate-prices, farm-prices, flights, fuel, groceries, health-insurance, home-sales, home-upgrades, hotels, insurance, land-prices, medical, medicines, price-levels, producer-prices, rent, surplus-auctions, tuition, wholesale-fresh-food, wholesale-markets, wholesale-power (the tool name also works).

country.description: Optional. Return the full detail of the sources that cover this country: an ISO code such as IE, GB or FR. Can be combined with category.

name: pricepaid_coverage

outputSchema.description: Which price tools, countries and official sources are covered: a short overview by default, or full per-source detail (licence, attribution, limits) for a category and/or country.

detail.description: summary = the short overview (the default); full = every matching source in full, for the category and/or country asked for.

examples.description: Detail full only: working example requests (REST paths) for the matching sources.

filter.description: The slice asked for (detail full only).

full_coverage_url.description: Every source at once, as JSON (REST).

source_count.description: How many sources the answer covers: all of them in the overview, the matching ones in a slice.

sources.description: Detail full only: each matching source with its publisher, licence, attribution line, update frequency and limits.

summary.description: One plain sentence an AI can quote, with how to get more detail.

category.description: The category id, to pass as category for a slice.

countries.description: ISO country codes the tool answers for.

name.description: The MCP tool to call for this kind of price.

update_frequency.description: How often the official sources behind this tool update; several sources are separated by ' | '.

title: What price data is covered
